title: Vehicle Repair Tracking Log
subtitle: General Vehicle Repair: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Vehicle Repair Tracking Log covers vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision. The service advisor records General Vehicle Repair events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Vehicle Repair Tracking Log keeps General Vehicle Repair exceptions visible until the service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Vehicle Repair Tracking Log at repair facility, service bay, test area, and customer handoff point. Document vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision identity before General Vehicle Repair begins. Compare vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision findings with stated General Vehicle Repair criteria; route unresolved General Vehicle Repair issues to qualified automotive repair reviewer. For Vehicle Repair Tracking Log, confirm requirements for General Vehicle Repair. Ask qualified automotive repair reviewer to review General Vehicle Repair conditions beyond the service advisor's role.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For General Vehicle Repair, identify responsible parties, repair facility, service bay, test area, and customer handoff point, and the linked vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision source.

fields.label: VIN, plate, year, make, model, and mileage
Reported symptom, operating condition, and prior repair

sections.title: Status variance and accountable response
sections.guidance: Capture General Vehicle Repair facts for vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: General Vehicle Repair tracked controls
items: Diagnostic trouble code and test result
Road test or stationary verification within authority

sections.title: Status decision and next trigger
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest General Vehicle Repair event before closeout. Service Advisor identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Vehicle cannot be safely tested or released
blocks.guidance: Pause General Vehicle Repair when a safety-critical condition, uncertain diagnosis, authorization gap, or failed verification remains. Retain the available General Vehicle Repair proof and route unresolved vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision scope to service advisor.
